The role also manages, builds the capacity of and fairly pays the pool of Accountability Volunteers (IWs), and keeps CFRM tools and reporting aligned with IRC and donor requirements. The officer will work closely with accountability volunteer, CFRM Focal Persons, facility focal points, program and partner staff and the line supervisor to strengthen client responsiveness and institutionalize the CFRM policy framework. Maintain the CFRM Focal Person list by location, grant and sector.
